description: This file contains functions for managing Broadcom wireless drivers, including scanning, enabling, disabling, and detecting Broadcom wireless devices, with configuration and network interface setup.

methods.name: scan_broadcom
methods.description: Scans for Broadcom wireless devices, configures their modes and interfaces based on current settings.

methods.name: disable_broadcom
methods.description: Disables a Broadcom wireless device, bringing interfaces down and removing driver configurations.

methods.name: enable_broadcom
methods.description: Enables and configures a Broadcom wireless device with specified parameters, setting up interfaces and network configurations.

methods.name: detect_broadcom
methods.description: Detects Broadcom wireless devices by parsing /proc/net/dev and initializes their configuration.
